Title: Select robust indicators based on missingness

  - missing_rate must match the fraction of missing values in outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv.
- outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv:
  - Keep city_id, city_name, year, and only indicator columns with missing_rate <= 0.30.

<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd

# Read the input file
input_file = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'
output_missing_file = 'outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv'
output_selected_file = 'outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv'

# Read the input CSV
df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

# Check if the input file exists
if df is None:
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Input file not found: {input_file}")

# Get all columns
all_columns = df.columns.tolist()

# Identify indicator columns (all columns except city_id, city_name, year)
# The exact structure depends on the input file
# We'll assume indicator columns are all columns except city_id, city_name, year

# Get indicator columns
indicator_columns = [col for col in all_columns 
                     if col not in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]

# Calculate missingness per indicator
missing_counts = {}
missing_rates = {}

for indicator in indicator_columns:
    indicator_values = df[indicator].isna()
    missing_count = indicator_values.sum()
    missing_rate = missing_count / len(df)
    
    missing_counts[indicator] = missing_count
    missing_rates[indicator] = missing_rate

# Create the missingness report
report = []
for indicator in indicator_columns:
    report.append({
        'indicator': indicator,
        'missing_count': missing_counts[indicator],
        'missing_rate': missing_rates[indicator],
        'kept': 1 if missing_rates[indicator] <= 0.30 else 0
    })

missingness_report = pd.DataFrame(report)
missingness_report.to_csv(output_missing_file, index=False, quoting=pd.ExcelWriter.quoting)

# Filter to keep indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30
filtered_missingness_report = missingness_report[missingness_report['missing_rate'] <= 0.30]

# Create the selected matrix with only indicator columns
selected_columns = [col for col in all_columns if col in filtered_missingness_report.columns]

# Create the selected matrix with city_id, city_name, year, and indicators
selected_data = df[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']].copy()
selected_data[selected_columns] = filtered_missingness_report[filtered_missingness_report.columns]

selected_matrix = selected_data[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + selected_columns]

selected_matrix.to_csv(output_selected_file, index=False, quoting=pd.ExcelWriter.quoting)
</solution_file>
